mapper.select: SELECT P.PROJECT_ID AS "projectId", P.PROJECT_NAME AS "projectName", P.DESCRIPTION AS "description", P.SOURCE_DIR AS "sourceDir", P.SCM_TYPE AS "scmType", P.SCM_URL AS "scmUrl", P.JAVA_VERSION AS "javaVersion", P.CURRENT_REVISION AS "currentRevision", P.USE_YN AS "useYn", P.UPDATED_AT AS "updatedAt", P.UPDATED_BY AS "updatedBy", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_management_project_db D WHERE D.PROJECT_ID = P.PROJECT_ID) AS "dbCount" FROM ai_management_project P ORDER BY P.PROJECT_ID

SELECT PROJECT_ID AS "projectId", PROJECT_NAME AS "projectName", DESCRIPTION AS "description", SOURCE_DIR AS "sourceDir", SCM_TYPE AS "scmType", SCM_URL AS "scmUrl", SCM_USERNAME AS "scmUsername", CASE WHEN SCM_PASSWORD_ENC IS NULL OR SCM_PASSWORD_ENC = '' THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END AS "hasScmPassword", JAVA_VERSION AS "javaVersion", WAS_CONTAINER AS "wasContainer", WAS_VERSION AS "wasVersion", CONTEXT_PATH AS "contextPath", BUILD_TYPE AS "buildType", BUILD_ARGS AS "buildArgs", BUILD_WEB_ROOT AS "buildWebRoot", BUILD_CLASSES_DIR AS "buildClassesDir", BUILD_LIB_DIR AS "buildLibDir", BUILD_SOURCE_DIRS AS "buildSourceDirs", CURRENT_REVISION AS "currentRevision", TEST_USER_ID AS "testUserId", TEST_STATIC_PATHS AS "testStaticPaths", TEST_ENTRY_GUIDE AS "testEntryGuide", CASE WHEN TEST_PASSWORD_ENC IS NULL OR TEST_PASSWORD_ENC = '' THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END AS "hasTestPassword", USE_YN AS "useYn" FROM ai_management_project WHERE PROJECT_ID = #{projectId}
SELECT TEST_PASSWORD_ENC FROM ai_management_project WHERE PROJECT_ID = #{projectId}
SELECT SCM_PASSWORD_ENC FROM ai_management_project WHERE PROJECT_ID = #{projectId}

SELECT DB_SEQ AS "dbSeq", DB_NAME AS "dbName", JDBC_URL AS "jdbcUrl", USERNAME AS "username", SCHEMA_NAME AS "schemaName", JNDI_NAME AS "jndiName", DESCRIPTION AS "description", SORT_ORDER AS "sortOrder", CASE WHEN PASSWORD_ENC IS NULL OR PASSWORD_ENC = '' THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END AS "hasPassword" FROM ai_management_project_db WHERE PROJECT_ID = #{projectId} ORDER BY SORT_ORDER, DB_SEQ

SELECT D.PROJECT_ID AS "projectId", P.PROJECT_NAME AS "projectName", D.DB_NAME AS "dbName", D.JDBC_URL AS "jdbcUrl", D.USERNAME AS "username", D.PASSWORD_ENC AS "passwordEnc", D.SCHEMA_NAME AS "schemaName", D.JNDI_NAME AS "jndiName", D.DESCRIPTION AS "description" FROM ai_management_project_db D JOIN ai_management_project P ON P.PROJECT_ID = D.PROJECT_ID WHERE P.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY D.PROJECT_ID, D.SORT_ORDER, D.DB_SEQ
SELECT PASSWORD_ENC FROM ai_management_project_db WHERE PROJECT_ID = #{projectId} AND DB_SEQ = #{dbSeq}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_management_project (PROJECT_ID, PROJECT_NAME, DESCRIPTION, SOURCE_DIR, SCM_TYPE, SCM_URL, SCM_USERNAME, SCM_PASSWORD_ENC, JAVA_VERSION, WAS_CONTAINER, WAS_VERSION, CONTEXT_PATH, BUILD_TYPE, BUILD_ARGS, BUILD_WEB_ROOT, BUILD_CLASSES_DIR, BUILD_LIB_DIR, BUILD_SOURCE_DIRS, TEST_USER_ID, TEST_PASSWORD_ENC, TEST_STATIC_PATHS, TEST_ENTRY_GUIDE, USE_YN, CREATED_AT, CREATED_BY, UPDATED_AT, UPDATED_BY) VALUES (#{projectId}, #{projectName}, #{description}, #{sourceDir}, #{scmType}, #{scmUrl}, #{scmUsername}, #{scmPasswordEnc}, #{javaVersion}, #{wasContainer}, #{wasVersion}, #{contextPath}, #{buildType}, #{buildArgs}, #{buildWebRoot}, #{buildClassesDir}, #{buildLibDir}, #{buildSourceDirs}, #{testUserId}, #{testPasswordEnc}, #{testStaticPaths}, #{testEntryGuide}, #{useYn}, now(), #{by}, now(), #{by}) ON CONFLICT (PROJECT_ID) DO UPDATE SET PROJECT_NAME = EXCLUDED.PROJECT_NAME, DESCRIPTION = EXCLUDED.DESCRIPTION, SOURCE_DIR = EXCLUDED.SOURCE_DIR, SCM_TYPE = EXCLUDED.SCM_TYPE, SCM_URL = EXCLUDED.SCM_URL, SCM_USERNAME = EXCLUDED.SCM_USERNAME, SCM_PASSWORD_ENC = EXCLUDED.SCM_PASSWORD_ENC, JAVA_VERSION = EXCLUDED.JAVA_VERSION, WAS_CONTAINER = EXCLUDED.WAS_CONTAINER, WAS_VERSION = EXCLUDED.WAS_VERSION, CONTEXT_PATH = EXCLUDED.CONTEXT_PATH, BUILD_TYPE = EXCLUDED.BUILD_TYPE, BUILD_ARGS = EXCLUDED.BUILD_ARGS, BUILD_WEB_ROOT = EXCLUDED.BUILD_WEB_ROOT, BUILD_CLASSES_DIR = EXCLUDED.BUILD_CLASSES_DIR, BUILD_LIB_DIR = EXCLUDED.BUILD_LIB_DIR, BUILD_SOURCE_DIRS = EXCLUDED.BUILD_SOURCE_DIRS, TEST_USER_ID = EXCLUDED.TEST_USER_ID, TEST_PASSWORD_ENC = EXCLUDED.TEST_PASSWORD_ENC, TEST_STATIC_PATHS = EXCLUDED.TEST_STATIC_PATHS, TEST_ENTRY_GUIDE = EXCLUDED.TEST_ENTRY_GUIDE, USE_YN = EXCLUDED.USE_YN, UPDATED_AT = now(), UPDATED_BY = EXCLUDED.UPDATED_BY

INSERT INTO ai_management_project_db (PROJECT_ID, DB_SEQ, DB_NAME, JDBC_URL, USERNAME, PASSWORD_ENC, SCHEMA_NAME, JNDI_NAME, DESCRIPTION, SORT_ORDER, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT) VALUES (#{projectId}, #{dbSeq}, #{dbName}, #{jdbcUrl}, #{username}, #{passwordEnc}, #{schemaName}, #{jndiName}, #{description}, #{sortOrder}, now(), now())
mapper.select: SELECT REVISION AS "revision", SCM_REVISION AS "scmRevision", STATUS AS "status", KIND AS "kind", WEB_ROOT AS "webRoot", CLASSES_DIR AS "classesDir", LIB_DIR AS "libDir", MAIN_CLASS AS "mainClass", MESSAGE AS "message", REQUESTED_BY AS "requestedBy", STARTED_AT AS "startedAt", FINISHED_AT AS "finishedAt" FROM ai_management_project_revision WHERE PROJECT_ID = #{projectId} ORDER BY STARTED_AT DESC

SELECT REVISION AS "revision", SCM_REVISION AS "scmRevision", STATUS AS "status", KIND AS "kind", WEB_ROOT AS "webRoot", CLASSES_DIR AS "classesDir", LIB_DIR AS "libDir", MAIN_CLASS AS "mainClass", MESSAGE AS "message", STARTED_AT AS "startedAt", FINISHED_AT AS "finishedAt" FROM ai_management_project_revision WHERE PROJECT_ID = #{projectId} AND REVISION = #{revision}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_management_project_revision (PROJECT_ID, REVISION, SCM_REVISION, STATUS, REQUESTED_BY, STARTED_AT) VALUES (#{projectId}, #{revision}, #{scmRevision}, 'BUILDING', #{by}, now()) ON CONFLICT (PROJECT_ID, REVISION) DO UPDATE SET STATUS = 'BUILDING', SCM_REVISION = EXCLUDED.SCM_REVISION, KIND = NULL, WEB_ROOT = NULL, CLASSES_DIR = NULL, LIB_DIR = NULL, MAIN_CLASS = NULL, MESSAGE = NULL, REQUESTED_BY = EXCLUDED.REQUESTED_BY, STARTED_AT = now(), FINISHED_AT = NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_management_project_revision SET STATUS = #{status}, KIND = #{kind}, WEB_ROOT = #{webRoot}, CLASSES_DIR = #{classesDir}, LIB_DIR = #{libDir}, MAIN_CLASS = #{mainClass}, MESSAGE = #{message}, FINISHED_AT = now() WHERE PROJECT_ID = #{projectId} AND REVISION = #{revision}
UPDATE ai_management_project_revision SET STATUS = 'FAILED', MESSAGE = '엔진이 다시 떠서 빌드가 중단됐습니다.', FINISHED_AT = now() WHERE STATUS = 'BUILDING'
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM ai_management_project_revision WHERE PROJECT_ID = #{projectId} AND REVISION = #{revision}
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_management_project SET CURRENT_REVISION = #{revision} WHERE PROJECT_ID = #{projectId}
